ingest.note: Audio sent back to the PSTN caller must be G.711 μ-law 8 kHz. This is what the bridge must hand Exotel.

egress.note: Inbound caller audio arrives as G.711 μ-law 8 kHz mono over the media-stream WebSocket. Narrowband.

potholes.note: Telephony audio is narrowband μ-law 8 kHz. No realtime model or STT consumes this directly. A decode (μ-law→PCM) and resample (8k→16k/24k) stage is mandatory before any model.
The media-stream WebSocket can close before the hangup webhook fires. Treat WebSocket close AND explicit hangup as terminal; do not wait for one to confirm the other.
WebSocket frames may split or coalesce audio arbitrarily. Reassemble by byte budget, not by message boundary, before resampling.
DTMF arrives as events, not in-band audio. Route it as a discrete signal; do not try to detect it from the audio stream.

No echo canceller exists in your bridge and Exotel offers no mark/clear — buffered outbound audio plays out, and carrier/speakerphone echo of the agent's own TTS into the inbound leg false-triggers VAD: the bot interrupts itself in a loop. Gate VAD while the agent speaks, or use orchestration-level AEC when available.

human_handoff=transfer on Exotel uses a Connect/transfer flow: a second leg to the human number. Blind transfer drops the agent leg; warm transfer needs a bridge/conference flow. Record the failure fallback (callback) in the contract — a no-answer transfer with no fallback strands the caller.

latency_evidence.methodology: Callsmith architecture-budget placeholder; benchmark in the deployment region before setting an SLO.

interruption.description: Stop sending audio frames to the media stream WebSocket. Buffered audio at the provider may play out — unavoidable unless you close and re-open the stream.
interruption.code_hint: On interruption: stop writing to the WebSocket. Exotel does not support mark/clear like Twilio.

hosted_option.name: exotel-cloud
hosted_option.note: Exotel runs the India carrier/media edge, not your agent. India-local media POPs make it the residency-friendly default for Indian regulated deployments — co-locate your worker in India.

deployment.self_host_notes: Your bridge/worker hosts wherever the orchestration pack says; keep it in India near the Exotel media POP or pay 150-300 ms of avoidable RTT on every audio frame.
